text_block_list.text:
On our way back from going out,
at Fine Motion's strong request,
we stopped by the Umamusume Shop.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! There are plushies of everyone,
clear files, and keychains too!
choice_data_list: Was there something you wanted to buy?
Was there something you wanted to buy?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, rather than something I want to buy,
it's more like something I want to learn♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I want to study what it means to have an "oshi"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Fa-fa-fa, Fine-san!?!?
Why is the pinnacle of all royal Umamusume
in a place like this...?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Today~, I came to learn all about the 'faves'
that Digital-chan is always talking so happily about♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I buy their merch, will that girl become my oshi?
Should I buy Digital-chan's?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!?!?!?!?
Please have mercy, I beg of youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "A-And besides that! Isn't that putting the cart before the horse, so to speak? You're supposed to get merch after you find a favorite to support!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: —Buying merch means always keeping your favorite close to your heart, a declaration of your unwavering support...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
By owning merch, your big love for your oshi
...in other words, your faith, will reach even greater heights!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see! When it comes to your faves,
asking Digital-chan is definitely the way to go♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital-chan,
would you mind teaching me more about your favs?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeeh?! I-I am truly unworthy!
For someone like me, m-m-myself, to lecture you on my fave—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I want Digital-chan to teach me!
Please!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
—When your fave begs you so passionately,
a true fan answers with everything they've got...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: “Yours truly, Agnes Digital, shall give you hands-on guidance in my way of stanning!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now then, you two!
You have your lights properly equipped, right?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oooh!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
Thank you for coming today!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We're going to spread our wings and fly even higher, so keep your eyes on Falco and the crew~!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the view from the front...
I will deliver a radiant song to you."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Operation 'Street Live'—
commence.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo~!! My faves are just so precious today too~!!
Can you see it? Their brilliance—no!
Their very way of life!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm!
Everyone is shining so brightly...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If you saw it, please answer my call...
Wave your penlights to your heart's content!
That is what it means to be a fan...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOO!!
Umapyoi!! Umapyoi!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Umapyoi! Umapyoi!
Go for it, umapyo~i♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Utter! Complete! Satisfaction!
choice_data_list: Did you learn about oshi, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Spot on♪ So an 'oshi' basically means
your favorite person that you want to support, right?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~ As expected of Your Highness!!
You possess the eyes to see right to the core of things!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: An oshi is an oasis that quenches the soul! A light that pierces the darkness!! The vital energy to live tomorrow!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My heart is struck by my oshi giving it her all! Energized by her shining figure! That is how Digi-tan overcomes her daily hardships!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
Having an idol you stan is really wonderful♪
choice_data_list: Do you have an oshi, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the kind words!
I hope that turns out to be true~.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“Saying 『someone』 though... hmm~
Does that mean you won't root for me, Trainer?”
choice_data_list: I've been rooting for you ever since we first met.
I've been rooting for you ever since we first met!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I see♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then as my Trainer's favorite, I've gotta show you
even more of my cool side!

Afterward—after parting with Agnes Digital, who insisted, "I cannot intrude upon such blessedness!"
the two of us headed home together.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Let's see. Digital-chan is cute, Shakur is so cool, and Groove-san is wonderful too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, watching you work harder than anyone right by my side,
and drawing strength from that..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, guess who?
Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhhh!!
An unexpected overkill right at the very end...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—distracted by caring for a collapsed Agnes Digital,
I never did find out who Fine Motion's favorite was.
